title: n8n Triggers Cheat Sheet (Day 1 of 7)
tldr: Every workflow starts with a trigger: Chat Trigger for messages, Schedule Trigger for a clock.
A scheduled workflow only runs after you publish it.

tools.name: n8n
tools.note: Cloud free trial, or self-host the free Community Edition

steps.title: Chat Trigger
steps.detail: Runs on each chat message; hosted chat is built in.

steps.title: Schedule Trigger
steps.detail: Seconds to months, or a cron expression.

steps.title: Timezone
steps.detail: Workflow timezone if set, else the instance timezone.

steps.title: Manual vs production
steps.detail: Only production runs count toward quota.

tips: Pick the trigger before you pick the nodes.
mistakes: Forgetting to publish a scheduled workflow.
